decisions.because: Round 8 on 9387b10: a flush or unban of more than about 1,900 own claims was one Retract frame over MAX_FRAME_BYTES; peers bailed before reading it and lost the retraction until the next connection's snapshot.

statement: Every retraction of this node's own claims that it broadcasts is packed into frames within SNAPSHOT_PAYLOAD_BUDGET, full and in order, so no retraction frame exceeds the transport limit and makes peers drop the connection with it.
